This file used to list 62 uncovered opcodes. For those, nothing verified
the wire shape -- round-trip tests are self-consistent by construction,
and mock-server tests are built from the same SDK types they check, so
all three agreed with each other and none agreed with anything external.
Both bugs found in the July audit lived in that gap.
Keep this file. It is not a to-do list any more, it is the mechanism:
each SDK asserts that every opcode it declares is either corpus-pinned
or named here. With the list empty, adding an opcode without a vector
fails immediately in all three languages. Adding a name back is a
deliberate act that has to be justified in review.
